name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 4 – Am 36
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 4a. Calls for a redirection of Horizon Europe funds towards technological innovation, and an end to its scattering on topics such as ‘Eco-Islam in Indonesia’, ‘White Islam: a new religion for Europeans’, ‘Integrating gender norms into innovation processes’, ‘Intersectional approach to energy solutions’ or ‘Gendered analysis of virtual reality’; calls for an end to the requirement to ‘integrate the gender dimension into research and innovation projects’ and to the obligation to ‘adopt a gender equality plan’ in order to apply for Horizon Europe funding;
